_meta._note: Chapter 59, Final test (ch59-test, new, the Book 6 capstone). Sixteen multiple-choice questions at 80 % (12/16 fails, 13/16 passes), two for each of eight strands: nominal roles (q01–02, Chapter 55), special nouns (q03–04, Chapter 56), weak verbs under لَمْ (q05–06, Chapter 57), five-verb mood (q07–08, Chapter 57), object versus preposition and two objects (q09–10, Chapter 58), fronting and the absolute object (q11–12, Chapters 58 and 55), Al-A'la (q13–14) and a participle and reported-speech transfer (q15–16, Chapter 58). Every question retrieves something that a lesson practised; none introduces a construction. Added 2026-10-04 in the proposal harvest, batch 7 (Docs/proposals/proposal-harvest-tracker.md), from Docs/proposals/chapter-59-content-proposal.md and its review amendments.
